private_family.reason_prior_zero: At the q witnesses, every distinct prior rational prime first entry and the relevant factor second entries are q-adic units; odd-prime unit/unit Hilbert symbols are +1.

infinite_independence.proof: For any q in P, compare the two Q_q receiver points t=3,4. Every previously selected class evaluates equally (indeed zero) on the pair, while E_q changes value. Hence E_q is not in the F2-span of the previous classes modulo constants. Dirichlet supplies infinitely many fresh q, so induction gives infinitely many independent classes.

block_diagonal_adelic_control.q7_control: 36-09DC controls A,B and leaves D zero; every E_q has zero evaluation on the selected Q_7 witnesses because q and f0 are 7-adic units.
block_diagonal_adelic_control.q11_control: 36-09DC controls D and leaves A,B zero; every E_q has zero evaluation on the selected Q_11 witnesses because q and f0 are 11-adic units.
block_diagonal_adelic_control.private_q_control: At its own Q_q place E_q can be toggled between 0 and 1/2 by t=3,4, while A,B,D and every E_r for r!=q evaluate zero on those selected witnesses.
block_diagonal_adelic_control.simultaneous_infinite_family_correction: Starting from any adelic point, choose the Q_7 and Q_11 components for A,B,D and independently choose each Q_q component for E_q. Cross-evaluations on all selected witness sets are zero, so all coordinates can be cancelled simultaneously.
